items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: Louis Armstrong later had one of those.

ctx.x: That's right, on the side. Yeah, I have one of those. I think, I'm not sure. We may have one of those around the house. Knife, I'm not mistaken. One of those small things, ratchets. Yeah. Practically everything to go with drums at that period, he had it.

Did he ever use a slapstick? Yes, he had one of those too. Did he have one of those? And I know some drummers, of course, Chinese used to play the solos on the slide whistle. Louis Armstrong later had one of those. That's right, Louis. Did your father ever? My father had one of those too.
Just about everything. My father had one of those and at one time my father, he didn't do it often, then the other fellas had a way that he would take the snare drum and he would holler through it.
